ind: ind — hail! greetings! (interjection; from i 'O' and nḏ 'greet'; ind ḥr·k 'hail to you', literally 'greetings to your face')
m-bꜣḥ: m-bꜣḥ — in the presence of, before (compound preposition: m 'in' + bꜣḥ 'presence', written with the phallus sign bꜣḥ)
nn: nn — not, there is not (negative particle; nn + noun 'there is no …'; nn + sḏm·f 'will not …', the negative of the future; nn with a sentence without a verb 'there is not, … is not') · a second word of the same spelling: these, those (demonstrative pronoun before its noun, in classical Egyptian joined to it by the genitive n, nn n X; in later texts also without it)
šn: šn — to revile, curse(?) (verb; reading and sense uncertain, perhaps for šnṯ 'revile')
ḥꜣwt: ḥꜣwt — innards, entrails(?) (noun; reading uncertain, written with the intestine as classifier)
ḥꜣty: ḥꜣty — heart, breast (noun; written with the forepart of a lion, ḥꜣt)
wꜣḏ: wꜣḏ — papyrus stem; papyrus-shaped column, sceptre or amulet (noun); green, fresh (adjective; verb wꜣḏ 'be green') (Budge: 'tablet')

__broaden__.in: in — by (naming the agent, as in ḏd in N "said by N"); (particle) it is … · a second word of the same spelling: to say, said (verb; normally after the words quoted: in·sn 'they say', in·k 'you said')
__broaden__.hrw: hrw — terror, dread · a second word of the same spelling: day (noun)
